interface.colorModeDescription: Choose between light and dark design or follow system settings.
interface.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the user interface.
interface.headerPositionDescription: Determine where the odometer should be displayed: automatic (based on screen orientation), left or top.
interface.turnDisplayDescription: Adjust the size and aspect ratio of the turn display.
interface.turnDisplaySizeDescription: Adjust the size of the turn display.
interface.aspectRatioDescription: Adjust the aspect ratio of the turn display.
interface.entryHeightDescription: Adjust the height of individual roadbook entries.
interface.testHitBoxDescription: Test the transparency settings by hovering over this area.

app.keepScreenOnDescription: Prevents the screen from turning off during navigation.
app.defaultMapStyleDescription: Sets which map style is shown by default when opening the route builder.
app.defaultRoutingProfileDescription: Sets which routing profile is used by default when opening the route builder.
app.odometerKeysDescription: Configure the keys for odometer control. These keys work globally in the application.
app.odometerDecreaseDescription: Key to decrease the odometer value
app.odometerIncreaseDescription: Key to increase the odometer value
app.roadbookScrollKeysDescription: Configure the keys for manual scrolling in the roadbook. These keys automatically switch from auto-follow mode to manual mode.
app.roadbookScrollUpDescription: Key to scroll up in the roadbook
app.roadbookScrollDownDescription: Key to scroll down in the roadbook
app.autoFollowToggleKeyDescription: Configure the key to toggle auto-follow mode on and off.
app.autoFollowToggleDescription: Key to toggle auto-follow mode on and off
app.roadbookScrollModeDescription: Choose between step-by-step scrolling (jumps from entry to entry) or continuous scrolling (smooth scrolling when holding the key).
app.roadbookScrollSpeedDescription: Adjust the speed of continuous scrolling. Higher values = faster scrolling.
app.closeDistanceThresholdDescription: Distance in meters at which roadbook entries are marked as 'close' (green background). Useful for recognizing short distances between turns.
app.offlineCacheDescription: Manage locally rendered PDF previews for saved roadbooks.
